frame_indexing: all indices zero-based; source timestamps are video-relative, NOT wallclock

transform.method: single full-image premultiplied-alpha LANCZOS resize, same integer placement for ALL six sequences; no foot snapping or local changes
transform.root_semantics: union center/lowest whole-package silhouette, Idle/Run registration convention; not a claim every heel is at root; all natural and generated source drift retained

keying.method: Run color-difference matte/unmix/despill, single identical algorithm for all frames
keying.cutoff_note: Run .10 cutoff left .12-.14-alpha magenta compression specks at attack frame-zero corners; use uniform .16 for every frame. No spatial cleanup, morphology or hand editing. No claim exact Idle key algorithm (not recorded).
keying.unmix_and_despill: foreground=(rgb-(1-a)*screen)/max(a,1e-5); D=max(0,min(R,B)-G) subtracted from R/B, repeated after resizing; alpha-zero RGB=0
keying.known_limit: original purple/white impact graphic remains; magenta key alters its transparent edges/color like all source pixels, not a clean VFX-separated pass

branch_rule: 1/2 recover independently only on interruption. Normal chain 1->2->3, then append light3_recover exactly once to return Idle. No 1/2 recovery or intervening Idle baked into continuous mainline. No recovery repeated in third mainline.
